summary: The recording waveform shows the recent loudness as scrolling bars across the full width, drawn on a canvas in currentColor, instead of six bars moving with one level.
howTo: Nothing to do. To color it, set color on [data-part="wave-container"] or an ancestor; to size it, give [data-element="waveform"] a height (default 24px). CSS that targeted the old span bars inside [data-element="waveform"] no longer applies and can be removed.
